title: Get Shooting Working End to End
description: Get shooting working end to end. Render error: Could not load /mesh/base.glb: Unexpected token '<', "<!doctype "... is not valid JSON — shooting's fixture references /mesh/base.glb but the plugin Cargo.toml declares no [[package.metadata.semio.assets]] mesh-collection, so Vite serves index.html instead of the GLB. Declare mesh-collection (same roots as puzzle3d: asset/metabolism/representation + asset/abbau-aufbau + placeholder), regenerate playground registry, and verify shooting scene + icon render end to end.
summary: Fixed shooting end-to-end mesh load. Root cause: shooting fixture references `/mesh/base.glb` but the plugin Cargo.toml declared no `[[package.metadata.semio.assets]]` mesh-collection, so Vite returned `index.html` and GLTFLoader failed with Unexpected token '<'. Declared the same mesh-collection as puzzle3d (metabolism/representation + abbau-aufbau + placeholder), regenerated the plugin registry, extended `startAssetServer` to serve mesh-collection/static-dir for wgpu Trunk/native, added Trunk proxies for `/mesh/` (plus fixture routes), and routed native GLB fetches through `SEMIO_ASSET_BASE_URL`. Verified: `/mesh/base.glb` returns `model/gltf-binary` with glTF magic; Playwright against `dev:shooting` (react) shows Scene+Icon chrome with one canvas and no render error; ui-styling vitest 54 passed; bun index.test 19 passed.
